description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule behavior, particularly reading and writing .gitmodules when not in the working tree. It sets up test scenarios, runs Git commands, and verifies outcomes related to submodule configurations and sparse checkouts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, executing the given commands and verifying success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or strings.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given filesystem path does not exist.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp for test setup.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules commands to run after the current test completes, typically for cleanup.
